description: Human-reviewed duplicate capability mappings. Generated audit CSV files must never be edited manually.

capabilities.rationale: BentoPDF owns the complete merge utility. R2H backend command retired after zero-consumer proof.
BentoPDF owns the complete split utility. R2H backend command retired after zero-consumer proof.
BentoPDF owns the complete watermark utility. R2H backend command retired after zero-consumer proof.
BentoPDF owns the header and footer utility. R2H backend command retired after zero-consumer proof.
R2H.AI-PDF is the canonical owner of Compare and keeps the active ComparePanel route. BentoPDF remains a separate optional surface; shared backend commands may remain shared.
R2H.AI-PDF is the canonical owner of OCR and keeps the active OcrPanel route. BentoPDF remains a separate optional surface; shared OCR backend services may remain shared.
R2H.AI-PDF is the canonical owner of Page Organizer and keeps the active PageOrganizer/usePageOrganizer transaction route. BentoPDF remains a separate optional surface.
R2H.AI-PDF is the canonical owner of visual Sign & Stamp and keeps SignStampPanel. BentoPDF remains a separate optional surface; this R2H path is not certificate-based digital signing.
R2H.AI-PDF is the canonical owner of visual stamps through SignStampPanel. BentoPDF remains a separate optional surface.
R2H.AI-PDF is the canonical owner of Forms and keeps FormsPanel for form creation. BentoPDF remains a separate optional surface; shared form backend commands may remain shared.
R2H.AI-PDF is the canonical owner of Forms and keeps FormsPanel for form filling. BentoPDF remains a separate optional surface; shared form backend commands may remain shared.
R2H editor is deeply integrated with sessions, AI actions, export, review, and persistence. It cannot be deleted as a simple duplicate without a separate product decision.
Text extraction is an internal dependency of R2H search, AI, RAG, engineering, and review workflows.
R2H local AI/RAG is an application-specific retained capability, not a removable duplicate.
